buf=bytearray(58)
buf[0:6]=b'AC1015'
def put_rl(pos,v):
    buf[pos:pos+4]=v.to_bytes(4,'little')
# byte 21 num_sections

    put_rl(pos,size); pos+=4
Path('/workspace/poc1.dwg').write_bytes(buf)
